Hi Samir,

Thanks for the specifics — attaching a brief security-summary with the items you requested. High level:
- Data residency: hosted API supports region pinning; we can discuss EU/US tenants on the call.
- Retention: token/usage logs retained 30 days by default; enterprise retention configurable.
- SOC 2: Redwood has a current Type II report; we can share the cover letter and scope under an NDA.
- Encryption: TLS1.3 in transit; AES-256 at rest for model and KV cache.
- Audit logs: API-level audit logs available (examples included in the sheet).

[Attachment: security-summary.xlsx]

If it helps, I'm available for a 20-min technical pre-call on Wed 12/15 08:00–09:00 PST (18:30–19:30 IST) or Wed 12/15 11:00–12:00 PST. If those don't work, we can do a 15-min async recorded demo.
